Vendored third-party assets — embedded into the binary via include_bytes!.
Downloaded 2026-08-17. Filenames carry the version, so they are served with a
one-year immutable cache header and never need a ?v= query.

To re-verify: `cd assets/vendor && sha256sum *` and compare with the sha256
lines below. To upgrade: download the new version, rename the file with the new
version number, update this file and the constants in src/routes/assets.rs.

name:    Chart.js
version: 4.4.7
file:    chart-4.4.7.umd.js
sha256:  2812cb8825fdc57469eb2f7bb055e9429244e599920511ee477e828499b632cb
source:  https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/chart.js@4.4.7/dist/chart.umd.js

note:    chart.js 4.4.7 publishes no chart.umd.min.js — the npm package ships
         chart.umd.js only, already minified. Requesting the .min.js path from
         jsdelivr returns that same file with the upstream banner swapped for a
         jsdelivr-generated one, so the canonical chart.umd.js is vendored
         instead and the filename drops ".min".
